name: cobalt-capture
description: Visual product feedback in shareable reviews: annotated screenshots and notes that people and AI assistants can read, write and share.

interface.longDescription:
Cobalt Capture turns product feedback into a shareable review: screenshots with notes and annotations, at a link anyone can open.

With Cobalt Capture connected to your account, ChatGPT can:

- Read any Cobalt review, including its notes and annotated screenshots.
- Create a review in your account and add screenshots of public web pages, rendered at desktop or mobile size, plus notes and a summary.
- Retake a screenshot in place, after asking you first.
- List your reviews, and look up the product teardowns Cobalt has published.

It is built for product managers, designers, founders and developers who want a QA pass, a page check or a product study captured as one review they can share.

Limits: it can only render public pages, not pages behind a login. It reaches only your own Cobalt reviews and Cobalt's published studies. It has no delete tool.
defaultPrompt: Screenshot a web page on mobile and save it as a review.
What did Cobalt find about Canva's pricing?

positive.description: Find and read a review in the signed-in account
positive.prompt: Using Cobalt Capture, list my reviews, then open the sample review and tell me what it found.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the account's reviews (the test account holds 'Canva pricing teardown (sample)') and summarizes that review's findings, which come back as text plus annotated screenshots.

positive.description: Capture a public page into a new review
positive.prompt: Create a Cobalt review called 'Pricing page check' with a desktop screenshot of https://cobaltcapture.com/pricing.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates the review in the signed-in account, renders the page server-side, adds it as the first screenshot, and returns the review link.

positive.description: Retake a screenshot at mobile size
positive.prompt: Now retake that screenshot at mobile size.
positive.expected_behavior: Asks for confirmation (destructive), then overwrites screenshot 1 in place with a 390px mobile render. The review still has one screenshot.

positive.description: Add a note and set the summary
positive.prompt: Add a note that the plan prices should sit higher on mobile, then set the review summary to 'Mobile pricing needs a look'.
positive.expected_behavior: Appends the note and sets the summary, which appears at the top of the review page.

positive.prompt: What did Cobalt find about Canva's pricing?
positive.expected_behavior: search returns the published study teardown:canva; fetch returns its text, and the answer summarizes the finding about Pro versus Business pricing.

negative.description: A review that does not exist. Should return a clear 'no review found' message and create nothing.
A page that is not public. add_screenshot refuses local and private addresses and explains why; nothing is stored.
negative.prompt: Add a screenshot of http://localhost:3000 to my Pricing page check review.

negative.description: Writing to a review owned by another account. The write is refused with a message that the review belongs to another account; nothing changes.
negative.prompt: Add a note saying hello to https://cobaltcapture.com/r/w332c8k8.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments. Cobalt Capture's optional paid plan is managed on cobaltcapture.com, never inside ChatGPT.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: read reviews, create reviews with server-rendered screenshots of public pages, retake screenshots, add notes and summaries, list your reviews, and search Cobalt's published studies.
